finding.title: Privileged outbox stage rebinding survived verification
finding.attack: Two OBSERVED stage rows were rebound to each other's immutable events after dropping and exactly restoring the delete trigger.
finding.observed: Store.verify returned valid=true with the original event count and head hash.
finding.consequence: A privileged local writer could corrupt outbox stage associations without changing the witnessed event-chain head, causing false integrity acceptance and deterministic replay denial of service.
finding.required_repair: Bind every materialized stage row to the outbox_id, request_id, disabled-dispatch flag and information boundary carried by its immutable source event.

nonclaim: One deterministic local integrity attack; it does not establish remote exploitability or complete the release review.
